beats.label: The study
beats.text: **100** adults with normal to high-normal BP did **wall** **squat** holds at home.
beats.note: Swift et al., BMJ Open Sport & Exerc. Med. 2026

beats.label: The routine
beats.text: **4** holds, **2** minutes of rest between, **3x** a week for a month.

beats.label: Then they cut back
beats.text: Just **once** **a** **week** kept top-number BP about **6.5** points below where they started.

beats.label: More kept more
beats.text: Staying at **3x** a week: about **13.7** points lower. Quitting **erased** the gains.

beats.label: Reality check
beats.text: Only **8** weeks, and no one had **hypertension.** On BP meds? Ask your **doctor** first.
Follow for fitness that fits a **busy** **week.**
